description: Lc0 0.32.1's UCI option sets, one per purpose, the counterpart of stockfish-profiles.json (laplace-uci --engine lc0 and the engine endpoint read both). Every option a profile names is sent and receipted; an option it does not name keeps the engine default. The network and backend come from chess-lab.env (LAPLACE_LC0_NET, LAPLACE_LC0_BACKEND): an Lc0 generation is the binary, the network, the backend and the GPU together (chess-ladder-release.json).

identity.note: cuda-fp16 on the RTX 4060 Ti (Ada); one Lc0 process at a time holds the card.

testimony.use: reproducible single-position evaluation: one search thread, a fixed node count, fresh state per position
testimony.search: go nodes N, ucinewgame before each independent position

analysis.use: single-position analysis on the GPU; not bit-reproducible
analysis.search: go nodes N or go movetime T

play.use: Lichess and match play on a clock; not bit-reproducible
play.search: a clock; MoveOverheadMs covers a loaded host or the network
